items.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 150 receiving yards, TD in Seahawks' win vs. Chiefs
items.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba wasn't the main story heading into Sunday night's Chiefs-Seahawks matchup -- but he emerged as the game's biggest star, continuing his own historic start by catching nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Seattle's 20-3 win.

items.headline: Seahawks contain Chiefs' Kenneth Walker III in RB's return to Seattle
items.description: Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III had his worst game of the season in his return to Seattle on Sunday night.

items.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, stifling defense help Seahawks hand Chiefs first loss
items.description: Seattle's bread and butter from its Super Bowl championship season -- Jaxon Smith-Njigba and defense -- was too much for the Chiefs.
